The distribution of practicing cardiologists across the regions reveals a stark geographic concentration in private specialist practices. According to the data on the number of specialist practices, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] is the clear leader among the measured areas, hosting 13 practices for [[praktiserende-kardiologer|Praktiserende kardiologer]] [^src1]. In sharp contrast, the other regions trail significantly, with [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] recording only 2 practices and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] having just 1 [^src1].

Because this comparison is drawn from a single dated section, it is not possible to establish temporal trends or determine whether this distribution has improved, declined, or remained flat over time. However, the current snapshot highlights a massive outlier: Region Hovedstaden possesses more than four times the combined total of specialist cardiology practices found in Region Midtjylland and Region Nordjylland [^src1]. This extreme disparity suggests that patients seeking private cardiology consultations outside the capital region face significantly limited access to specialized care. No specific targets, thresholds, or standards are recorded in the provided data to evaluate whether these regional allocations meet established healthcare goals.
